name: eBay Stores

sources.title: eBay selling landing page — list an item, fees FAQ, business selling tools

conditions: Account creation and listing are free for the first 250 listings per month; $0.35 insertion fee per listing after that
A 10-15% final value fee is charged when an item sells — listing itself is free but the platform is fee-on-sale
Selling requires verifying the account and setting up payment/payout details during the first listing flow
requirements: A physical/digital good to sell — eBay is a marketplace for items, not a product-launch directory; a SaaS product listing would need to fit eBay's allowed item categories
Phone verification (call or text) during account setup for new sellers
Payout method (bank account) to receive payments
preparation: Item title with searchable keywords (brand, model, size), photos from multiple angles, condition notes
Pricing decision: Auction vs Buy It Now, plus optional Best Offer
Shipping plan (carrier choice, eBay discounted label, or Local Pickup)
Phone for verification and bank details for payouts
workflow: Go to https://www.ebay.com/sl/sell and click 'Sell now' / 'List an item'
Create/verify an eBay account (phone call or text verification) and set up payment information during the first listing
Use the quick listing flow — enter what you're selling, accept/refine AI-suggested category, title, price
Choose format (Auction or Buy It Now), set shipping, and publish the listing
For a persistent brand presence, look at Business selling tools / eBay Stores subscription via 'Learn more' under 'Selling as a business'
watchFor: Fee model: free to list (up to 250/mo) but 10-15% of final value on sale — a 'launch listing' here only makes sense for something actually sellable
Listings are transactional and expire; not a durable directory profile unless running an eBay Store
Prohibited/restricted items and IP rules apply
An eBay Store subscription is a separate paid product — the free route is individual listings
countsAsLive: A public item listing at ebay.com/itm/<id> (or a public Store page at ebay.com/str/<store>) reachable without login
unknowns: Whether a digital/SaaS product can be listed compliantly and in which category
eBay Store subscription pricing for a persistent storefront page
